command.config: &6[SteveHUD] &rThe settings screen is a client command: type &e/shudconfig&r in game. The server cannot open it, because those settings belong to your own client.
command.resend.players_only: &6[SteveHUD] &rOnly a player can receive the greeting.
command.scene.current: &6[SteveHUD] &rCurrent scene: &e%s&r. Set one with /stevehud scene full|compact|minimal
command.scene.invalid: &6[SteveHUD] &rScene must be one of full, compact, minimal.
command.clock.invalid: &6[SteveHUD] &rUse mm:ss or a number of seconds.
command.demo.started: &6[SteveHUD] &rDemonstration running: every element is exercised on a loop, on every client.
command.layout.none: &6[SteveHUD] &rNo server-wide package. Every client draws its own &econfig/stevehud/layout.json&r.
command.layout.author: (set by %s)
command.layout.set: &6[SteveHUD] &rServer-wide package is now &e%s&r. Every client and overlay will draw it.
command.layout.cleared: &6[SteveHUD] &rServer-wide package cleared. Every client is back to its own local package.
